scenario.title: Illustrative one-year Finnish corporate credit-loss scenarios

input_status.exposure_eur: Observed outstanding loan balance used as fixed EAD proxy
input_status.baseline_pd: Assumed; common across sectors to isolate composition and stress choices
input_status.baseline_lgd: Assumed; common across sectors to isolate composition and stress choices
input_status.adverse_parameters: Assumed; not estimated or calibrated to economic series

economic_narrative.baseline: Reference-date exposures held fixed over one year; common teaching assumptions for PD and LGD.
economic_narrative.adverse: Weaker activity raises default risk. Lower collateral values and more difficult recoveries raise loss severity. Sector differences are chosen assumptions, not empirical coefficients.
economic_narrative.macro_link: Observed bankruptcies provide historical context only. No quantitative macro-to-PD or macro-to-LGD relationship is fitted or claimed.

units.lgd: Fraction of exposure lost conditional on default
units.adverse_pd_multiplier: Multiplicative factor applied to baseline PD

scenario.capping: Validate inputs first, cap stressed PD and LGD at 1, report affected sector counts.

sensitivity.interpretation: Uniform shocks to baseline across sectors, separate from sector-specific adverse scenario. Not a confidence interval.
